verdict.rationale: CrewAI describes itself as an open-source framework that installs locally via `uv tool install crewai` and runs crews through its own CLI. AMP's managed infrastructure is positioned as an optional extension, and the framework supports multiple LLM providers; a community user reports running crews with local Ollama models. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of fully self-hosted production deployment, confirmation of no required vendor services or telemetry, and an independent account of running entirely on one's own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can run my agents entirely on my own infrastructure with no dependence on the vendor's platform

citations.quote: CrewAI AMP extends the power of the open-source framework with features designed for production deployments, collaboration, and scalability.
Run the following command to install crewai CLI: uv tool install crewai
The CrewAI CLI provides a set of commands to interact with CrewAI, allowing you to create, train, run, and manage crews & flows
CrewAI integrates with multiple LLM providers through providers native sdks, giving you the flexibility to choose the right model for your specific use case
